no_findings_rationale: C1 (component-boundary preservation) — §3 ADR-01 row + §4 table cross-checked against the real ADR-01 (docs/05_ADR/ADR-01.md §3, lines 110-120): ADR-01 fixes only an app-tier-caller-authN -> least-privilege-DB-role translation at the API->Store boundary and declares no authenticated end-user owner identity. The CHG's 'boundary-impact: amended-by-ADR-02 (ADR-01 touched, delta owned by ADR-02, no ADR-01 interface change)' is architecturally defensible — the decision is recorded and routed, not silently re-decided. C2 (new component -> new ADR) — §3 ADR-02 row names ADR-02 as REQUIRED for the net-new metrics store, owner-identity/authn model + authz boundary, and metrics-service trust-boundary class (in-process/out-of-process/external explicitly enumerated, clearing the beyond-checklist trust-boundary-class concern). C3 (interface stability) — verified against SPEC-01 §3 lines 167-188: increment_visit(code, event_id)->None and VisitCountRecord{code,count,dedup_key} are genuinely unchanged; per-visit rolling-window timestamps are a distinct data shape correctly housed on a separate additive path (SPEC-02) rather than mutating the count contract, and SPEC-01 §4 (lines 259-265) carries an additive-backward-compatible schema-evolution policy — no in-place mutation. C4 (SPEC update declared) — SPEC-02 named for new behavior; SPEC-01 marked no-touch with stated rationale consistent with §4 policy. C5 (backward compatibility) — §2 explicitly declares additive posture, no broken Shorten/Redirect/Mapping-Store contract, forward-only migration, no MAJOR bump. SE-3 at-rest mirror cross-checked against ADR-01 lines 195-200: 'least-privilege grant + managed-tier volume encryption' matches the CHG §2 claim in substance, so the new may-contain-PII path is held to ADR-01's boundary standard, not a weaker one. Fixer-touched locations (§2, §3 BDD/TDD/EARS rows + async-capture analysis, §4 table, §4.1, §6, §7.2) introduce no architectural regression — the added owner-identity EARS/BDD requirement gives the new authn/authz trust boundary an upstream trace (eliminating the orphan-trust-boundary risk), and the §4 table ADR-01/SPEC-01 'boundary-impact (no edit)' rows are consistent with §3. No deviation from upstream-required attributes; C1-C5 all clear.
